title: Southwest Flies Only One Type Of Plane. It's Saving Them Hundreds Of Millions.
description:
Educational purposes only. Not financial advice.

Southwest Airlines has built its entire fleet around one aircraft family, the Boeing 737. That single decision means one training program for pilots and mechanics, one set of spare parts to stock, and total flexibility to swap crews and aircraft across routes. Airlines with mixed fleets carry all of that complexity multiplied by however many aircraft types they fly.
